jobs.proposal_text: You need a RAG chatbot for your non-profit docs. I have built document Q&A assistants with Retrieval-Augmented Generation using LangChain and FastAPI, as shown in the e-commerce RAG bots. I also designed a multi-step support agent with async job workers and human approval, delivering the solution with LangGraph and Python. I will deliver a dashboard for the team and provide weekly progress updates as outlined. Would you like me to share a brief implementation plan for the first sprint?

You need to improve your Pinecone pipeline for your e-commerce company. I have shipped a Pinecone solution for an e-commerce client, matching your requirements. I will design an async Python backend using best practices and can provide a short implementation plan. I will provide weekly progress updates and a shared dashboard for the team. I can start this week. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the current pipeline architecture?

You need an Airflow expert for your marketing agency prototype. I have shipped Docker containers for SaaS and healthcare clients, demonstrated in my proposals. I designed an LLM evaluation harness for a non‑profit chatbot, illustrating my work with LLM orchestration frameworks. I can deliver a comprehensive test suite and a shared dashboard as part of the prototype. Would you like me to share a brief architecture diagram before we begin?

You need an ML engineer for a PyTorch model to handle deep learning model training, LLM chains and tools, Hugging Face, and Python with weekly progress updates and a test suite. I have delivered fine‑tuned open models for ticket classification in both edtech and fintech domains using Hugging Face and PyTorch, reducing manual processing time. I will provide weekly progress updates and a comprehensive test suite as part of the deliverables. Could we schedule a brief call to discuss the specific model requirements and timeline?

You need an LLM agent built with LangChain and retrieval‑augmented answers over PDFs for your real‑estate workflows. I will provide weekly progress updates and a comprehensive test suite to ensure reliable PDF retrieval. I can start this week and will share a short implementation plan on a call.

You need to improve your LLM evaluation pipeline. I have designed and delivered LLM evaluation harnesses that automated manual, slow processes for a legal chatbot. I will provide a short handover document and a comprehensive test suite as part of the deliverables. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the current pipeline and outline the improvement plan?

You need an LLM agent built with Python and scikit-learn for your logistics operations. I have solid Python backend experience, as reflected in client reviews and my CV. In 2026 I migrated an edtech web app to AWS, cutting hosting costs by 31%, demonstrating my ability to deliver measurable performance improvements. I will design the LLM agent to use a managed vector database by evaluating cloud‑native options such as Pinecone or AWS OpenSearch, ensuring scalability without compromising data security. Weekly progress updates and a comprehensive test suite will be part of the deliverables, aligning with your expectations. Could we schedule a brief call to discuss the specific logistics workflows you want the agent to handle?

I have built FastAPI back‑ends integrated with PostgreSQL, such as an edtech platform where I eliminated double‑bookings across 7,000 records. I can deliver a complete test suite covering API endpoints with pytest and UI components with React Testing Library, ensuring reliable MVP delivery. I can start this week and will share a short implementation plan during a brief call. Would you like to schedule a 15‑minute call to review the plan and align on the repository setup?

You need to fix and extend your FastAPI dashboard. I have delivered FastAPI back‑ends integrated with PostgreSQL for an edtech client, matching your stack. I can start this week and will share a short implementation plan on a call. The deliverables will include a deployed demo and a comprehensive Playwright test suite. Would you like to schedule a 15‑minute call to discuss the implementation roadmap?

I built a demand‑forecast model for a travel distributor using Python, which directly aligns with your monthly KPI forecasting requirement. I measured the uplift of a change in a checkout experiment for a non-profit store, identifying a 42% conversion increase with 95% confidence. I will deliver a shared dashboard and a concise handover document, and I can set up a reproducible container environment using standard Docker practices. I can start this week and would like to schedule a brief call to discuss your KPI definitions and data sources. When would be a convenient time for a 15‑minute call to review the project scope?

You need a dbt expert for monthly KPIs, requiring dbt, Snowflake, and Google Sheets. I built automated reporting solutions in Google Sheets for agencies, demonstrating the ability to integrate Sheets with data pipelines. In a recent e‑commerce warehouse modelling project I reduced dashboard refresh time from 3 hours to 1 minute, showing my skill in optimizing data workflows. I can start this week and will provide a short implementation plan on our first call. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the test suite and progress‑update cadence?

You need a Pandas dashboard for your healthcare team. I also built executive dashboards, such as a sales performance dashboard for a non‑profit and an Executive KPI workbook for a fintech group. My dbt models have been praised for solid communication and reliable performance. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the data sources and timeline?

You need a data analyst who can work with Pandas and build a WordPress site for your logistics company. I have delivered Pandas solutions for a logistics client, integrating data pipelines and SQL queries. I would implement automated tests for each Pandas transformation and forecast model using pytest and data validation checks to ensure reliability. For the WordPress component, I will outline a plan to integrate data visualizations via plugins or custom code, leveraging my data expertise. I can start this week and will provide weekly progress updates as requested. Could we schedule a brief call to discuss your exact data sources and WordPress integration needs?

You need a data analyst who can handle statistics and Solidity for your legal company. I have delivered cloud data warehouse solutions using dbt and Snowflake for both a healthcare team and an e‑commerce team, automating manual processes and speeding up reporting. I built shared spreadsheet automation, including an executive KPI workbook for a fintech group, and wrote Python scripts that refresh Google Sheets data. While I have not yet documented significance testing, I can design and implement appropriate statistical tests to meet your analytical needs. Would you like to schedule a short call to discuss the specific statistical models and Solidity components you require?

You need to analyse logistics data with Google Sheets and deliver a shared, automated spreadsheet dashboard. I have delivered automated, shared spreadsheet solutions, such as the executive KPI workbook for a fintech group, using Google Sheets scripting and XLOOKUP functions. I can set up weekly progress updates and share the dashboard with the team via Google Sheets' sharing features, following the automation patterns I have implemented. Would you like me to outline the first set of metrics and automation steps in a brief plan?

You need a data analyst proficient in Bigquery and A/B testing for your healthcare company. I have built demand forecasts with confidence intervals using Python, as demonstrated for a travel distributor. In a non‑profit checkout experiment, I measured a 42% conversion uplift at 95% confidence, showcasing my A/B testing expertise. I can provide a short handover document and weekly progress updates as part of the deliverables. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the project timeline and next steps?
